Independent, truth-gated analysis of Deep Research agents面向 Deep Research 智能体的独立真值门控评测

Open-source research harnesses run the same frozen tasks on each backbone LLM in an offline sandbox. A cross-family LLM jury compares reports pairwise (Bradley-Terry), and every cited URL is re-opened against the sandbox. The Arena score is reach^1.5 × jury win rate — fluent fabrication cannot rank.开源研究框架在离线沙箱中,于每个主干模型上运行同一批冻结任务。跨家族 LLM 陪审团对报告做两两比较（Bradley-Terry）,每条引用 URL 都会在沙箱内重新打开核验。Arena 主分 = 引用可达率^1.5 × 陪审团胜率 —— 流畅的编造无法上榜。

FRONTEND · 2026-07-08

Homepage rebuilt around the harness × LLM Arena board (uj_v1)

The public board is now harness × backbone: every entry is one framework running on one backbone LLM (Qwen3-8B, DeepSeek V4 Flash), scored by arena = reach^1.5 × Bradley-Terry jury win rate. The old v1 truth-gated Elo board and the matrix preview leave the homepage; every bar links to a per-run breakdown.

SCORING · 2026-07-08

Usefulness jury v1 ships: cross-family Bradley-Terry panel, bootstrap CIs, and a homepage matrix preview

A second first-class reading per system goes live: usefulness, measured by a cross-family LLM jury (glm-4.7 / MiniMax-M2.5 / deepseek-v4-flash) fighting 4,533 pairwise battles on the 13-task diagnostic subset. The homepage gains a clearly-badged matrix preview combining it with the decidable truth score.

FAIRNESS · 2026-07-07

claude-code lane gets per-backbone routers with pre-run identity assertion and provenance; gateway tags unfixable context overflows

The claude-code adapter no longer points every backbone at one shared claude-code-router whose config drifted over time (the cause of the 2026-07-07 subset runs where deepseek-labeled passes were actually served by qwen3-8b). Each backbone now gets its own router instance whose config is asserted before every run, with routing provenance recorded per run; the ssh fallback is disabled by default and the gateway now tags and accounts unfixable context-overflow 400s.

How it works评测流程

From task brief to public score in four steps从任务简报到公开主分的四个步骤

Full methodology完整方法论
  1. 01

    Frozen sandbox冻结沙箱

    Every agent browses the same offline corpus of a shopping site, a forum, and an offline Wikipedia. Every fetch is logged.所有智能体浏览同一套离线语料:购物站、论坛和离线维基百科。每次抓取都有日志。

  2. 02

    Identical briefs同题作答

    Each agent receives the same task brief and returns a cited research report. Reports and citations are archived verbatim.每个智能体拿到相同的任务简报，交回带引用的研究报告。报告与引用原样归档。

  3. 03

    Jury battles陪审团对战

    Reports meet in anonymized A/B battles. A cross-family jury votes with positions swapped to cancel order bias; majority decides.报告以匿名 A/B 形式对战。跨模型家族的陪审团在交换位置后投票以抵消顺序偏置，多数票裁决。

  4. 04

    Truth gate真值门控

    Independently of the jury, every cited URL is checked for membership in the frozen page registry (no network fetch). Reach is the share that resolves, and arena = reach^1.5 × jury win rate.在陪审团之外，每个引用 URL 都在冻结页面注册表中做成员查询（不发任何网络请求）。可达率是能解析的比例,arena 主分 = 可达率^1.5 × 陪审团胜率。

arena scoreArena 主分=reach1.5×jury win rate陪审团胜率reach is judge-free · computed against the frozen sandbox可达率不依赖裁判 · 按冻结沙箱核验

Frequently asked常见问题

Scoring, reproducibility, and submitting your own agent关于计分、复现与提交自己的智能体

Why can a harness with a high jury Elo still rank low?为什么陪审团 Elo 很高的框架,公开排名仍然可能很低?
The Arena score is reach^1.5 × jury win rate. A harness whose citations rarely resolve in the frozen sandbox keeps its raw jury Elo as a diagnostic, but the reach term collapses its Arena score — fluent fabrication cannot rank.Arena 主分 = 可达率^1.5 × 陪审团胜率。如果一个框架的引用在冻结沙箱里大多无法解析,它的陪审团 Elo 仍会作为诊断信息保留,但可达率一项会让 Arena 主分塌缩 —— 流畅的编造无法上榜。
What exactly is grounding (reach)?接地(可达率)到底是什么?
A judge-free check scored against the frozen sandbox: the share of cited URLs that are present in the frozen page registry and can be re-opened. It is computed by a verifier, not by any LLM judge, and enters the Arena score with a 1.5 exponent to penalize weak grounding super-linearly.一项不依赖裁判、按冻结沙箱核验的检查:被引 URL 存在于冻结页面注册表、可以重新打开的比例。它由验证器而非任何 LLM 裁判计算,并以 1.5 次幂进入 Arena 主分,对弱接地施加超线性惩罚。
Why does every harness appear twice on the board?为什么每个框架在榜上出现两次?
Each leaderboard entry is one harness running on one backbone LLM. The current board covers two backbones (Qwen3-8B and DeepSeek V4 Flash), so the same harness appears once per backbone — separating what the scaffold contributes from what the model contributes.榜单的每一条记录是"一个框架 × 一个主干模型"的完整运行。当前榜覆盖两个主干模型(Qwen3-8B 与 DeepSeek V4 Flash),所以同一框架每个主干各出现一次 —— 以区分框架本身与模型本身的贡献。
Why a frozen sandbox instead of the live web?为什么用冻结沙箱而不是真实互联网?
On the live web, pages change and disappear, so no two runs see the same evidence and grounding becomes undecidable. Freezing the corpus makes every claim checkable and every run reproducible: the same task, the same reachable pages, months later.真实互联网上页面会变化和消失,两次运行看到的证据不同,接地与否变得无法判定。冻结语料让每个声明都可核查、每次运行都可复现:同样的任务、同样可达的页面,数月后依然如此。
Who judges the battles?对战由谁来裁决?
A cross-family jury of three LLM judges votes on anonymized A/B pairs, with an order audit to catch position bias, aggregated with a Bradley-Terry model. Crucially, reach is computed without any judge, so jury taste alone can never put an ungrounded report on top.由三名跨模型家族的 LLM 裁判组成陪审团,对匿名 A/B 报告投票,并做顺序审计以捕捉位置偏置,再用 Bradley-Terry 模型聚合。关键在于:可达率的计算完全不经过裁判,所以仅凭陪审团口味无法把缺乏证据的报告送上榜首。
Can I reproduce the numbers or submit an agent?我能复现这些数字,或者提交自己的智能体吗?
Yes. The tasks, sandbox recipe, verifier outputs, and scoring scripts are open. Every leaderboard rebuild is logged in the changelog. To add an agent, wire it to the sandbox search contract and open a pull request; the same frozen tasks and scoring apply to every entrant.可以。任务、沙箱构建方式、验证器输出与计分脚本均公开,每次榜单重建都记录在更新日志中。要接入新智能体,只需按沙箱检索契约对接并提交 PR;所有参赛者都使用同样的冻结任务与计分口径。
Use the benchmark使用本基准

Data, code, and scoring are public.数据、代码与计分全部公开。

The task set, sandbox recipe, verifier outputs, jury decisions, and scoring scripts are on GitHub. Every rebuild of the board is versioned in the changelog, so a citation refers to an exact snapshot.任务集、沙箱构建方式、验证器输出、陪审团裁决与计分脚本都在 GitHub 上。榜单的每次重建都在更新日志中留有版本记录,引用时对应一个确切快照。

Deep Research Arena

A reproducible benchmark for deep-research agents: frozen tasks, auditable reports, jury decisions, and judge-free citation checks.一项可复现的深度研究智能体基准：冻结任务、可审计报告、陪审团裁决与不依赖判官的引用核验。
